content.comment_body: Hello, is there any battery module available for [product_name] [article_no]?

Hello, I don't believe such a module exists, since there is no slot to insert it (the programming slot was present in earlier versions). For details, see: [url] and consult the manual for further information. Regards,

Hi, for [product_name] [article_no] there isn't a battery module available. The backup duration for the real-time clock has been increased from 80 hours (previous version without battery) to 20 days/480 hours ([article_no]). Please refer to the most recent manual for details. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user inquires about the possibility of adding a battery module to a specific [product_name] version, but responses clarify that such a module is not available for this hardware. The backup time of the RTC has been improved in the newer version, which provides extended backup but does not directly replace the battery module's functionality.
